items.source: To customize the weaver used, the @Configuration class annotated with @EnableLoadTimeWeaving may also implement the LoadTimeWeavingConfigurer interface and return a custom LoadTimeWeaver instance through the #getLoadTimeWeaver method:
items.translation: 要自定义使用的织入器，可以添加 `@EnableLoadTimeWeaving` 注解的 `@Configuration` 类实现 LoadTimeWeavingConfigurer 接口，并通过 #getLoadTimeWeaver 方法返回自定义的 LoadTimeWeaver 实例：

items.source: The two examples are equivalent with one significant exception: in the XML case, the functionality of <context:spring-configured> is implicitly enabled when aspectj-weaving is "on". This does not occur when using @EnableLoadTimeWeaving(aspectjWeaving=ENABLED). Instead you must explicitly add @EnableSpringConfigured (included in the spring-aspects module)
items.translation: 这两个示例在功能上是等效的，但有一个显著例外：在 XML 配置中，当 `aspectj-weaving` 设置为 "on" 时，`<context:spring-configured>` 的功能会隐式启用。而在使用 `@EnableLoadTimeWeaving(aspectjWeaving=ENABLED)` 时则不会发生这种情况。相反，您必须显式添加 `@EnableSpringConfigured`（包含在 `spring-aspects` 模块中）。

items.source: The code example differs from the XML example in that it actually instantiates the MyLoadTimeWeaver type, meaning that it can also configure the instance, for example, calling the #addClassTransformer method. This demonstrates how the code-based configuration approach is more flexible through direct programmatic access.
items.translation: 该代码示例与 XML 示例不同之处在于，它实际上实例化了MyLoadTimeWeaver类型，这意味着还可以配置该实例，例如调用#addClassTransformer方法。这展示了基于代码的配置方法如何通过直接的程序访问而更加灵活。
